integrity: The proof is a direct slice argument. The lower witness uses only finitely many coordinates of an \(\ell_1\)-dual functional, so it lies in the \(c_0\)-sum; the zero selected dual coordinate is treated separately. The upper bound combines finitely many component slices and proves the required tail floor before using it. No computation is used as a substitute for proof.
limitations: The theorem is for real Banach spaces and the Daugavet constant on \(c_0\)-sums (finite families are finite \(\ell_\infty\)-sums). No \(\Delta\)-constant, complex-space, or infinite \(\ell_\infty\)-product analogue is claimed. Bibliographic noncoverage outside the inspected literature remains possible.
title: Exact Daugavet constants of arbitrary \(c_0\)-sums
